info.description:
# Kangwifi APIs

**315 endpoint** gratis, tanpa API key.

Support **GET** (query params) dan **POST** (JSON body).

```bash
# GET
curl "/ai/chatdeep?prompt=halo"

# POST (recommended)
curl -X POST "/ai/chatdeep" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"halo"}'
```

get.description:
Kirim pesan ke Qwen model lewat API Android Qwen Chat (chat.qwen.ai). Mendukung: chat teks, vision (lampirkan gambar/video via URL), web search, thinking/reasoning, text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video. Model: qwen3.7-plus (default), qwen3.7-max, qwen3.6-plus, qwen3-vl-plus, qwen3-coder-plus, qwen3.5-plus, qwen3.5-omni-plus, dll.

**RECOMMENDED: Gunakan POST** — lebih mudah di HP/Hoppscotch:
```
POST /ai/qwen
Content-Type: application/json
{"prompt": "Jelaskan relativitas", "model": "qwen3.7-plus"}
```
